preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
The size of permutation n must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a[i] < n for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: All elements of permutation a must be distinct integers from 0 to n-1.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of similar permutations modulo 10^9 + 7.
